verdict.rationale: Riskified does take in confirmed fraud outcomes. Merchants can report chargebacks through the chargeback endpoint, or automatically via gateway integrations (Adyen, Stripe, Braintree, PayPal). The onboarding docs also mention the analytics team calibrating models. However, nothing says this outcome data retrains the models or rules, and there is no mechanism for an analyst's own review decisions to feed back. Missing for 10: documented use of chargeback/fraud outcomes to retrain models or rules, a path for analyst review decisions to feed back, ongoing (not just onboarding) model learning, independent corroboration.
